resources.string: "Choose the app language. Your choice is saved."
"Understand your app habits without setting limits."
"Allow usage access to see time and opens for each app. No blocking rules or accessibility access are required."
"Opens count foreground visits. Quick screen changes within the same app count as one visit."
"Could not load history. Check usage access and try again."
"Records accumulate on this device for up to 30 days. Earlier records and collection gaps may be missing. The home screen is excluded. Split-screen and picture-in-picture totals may differ."
"Allow usage access, use another app, then refresh."
"Check the service connection. Blocking may not work right now."
"Small limits, more room in your day."
"Choose an app and set a time or open limit that works for you."
"Only selected apps are shown. Opens may be missing while monitoring is interrupted."
"Apps: %1$d · Essential apps such as Settings, Home and Phone are excluded."
"Try another search or check all apps."
"Normal mode is active. You can edit or delete rules at any time, revoke permissions or uninstall the app in Android settings."
"Device and battery settings may delay detection and blocking. Split-screen and picture-in-picture blocking are not supported yet."
"Usage records are kept for up to 30 days, on this device only. They are never sent to a server."
"All rules and records will be deleted and blocking will stop. This cannot be undone."
"Apps to block: %1$d. These apps stay blocked until focus ends. Apps added later are not included in this session."
"Existing rules stay in place. You can end focus at any time."
"Time, open and schedule limits remain after focus ends."
"First choose apps to block in the App limits tab."
"Take a break and focus on what matters now. Apps to pause: %1$d."
"Enable permissions and check monitoring to begin."
"A suggestion based on your history is ready. Existing limits are kept; only empty fields were filled. Review before saving."
"Presets change the fields below. Changes apply only after saving."
"Blank fields have no limit. Multiple limits apply together."
"Leave the app after reaching a session limit. Add a wait to avoid reopening immediately."
"Blocking starts on the selected days. An earlier end time continues into the next day."
"Up to 24 hours · Minutes/seconds: 0–59\nClear all three fields for no daily limit."
"Up to 24 hours · Minutes/seconds: 0–59\nClear all three fields to turn this limit off."
"After at least 3 recorded days, suggestions reflect your habits and existing limits."
"Uses local records for selected apps only. Monitoring gaps may be missing. Save to apply a suggestion."
"5 minutes per visit · Wait 10 minutes before reopening"
"5 opens a day · 3 minutes per visit"
"Block daily from 23:00 to 07:00 the next day"
"Choose a look. Your choice is saved."
"Warm ink with an orange accent · Flexoki"
"Warm dawn light with a violet accent · Rosé Pine"

"ChronoLock uses app-switch events to identify the active app and display a blocking screen according to your limits. It does not read screen text, passwords or typed content. Selected app package names and usage/blocking records stay on this device and are not transmitted. You can revoke access in Android settings at any time. If you agree, enable ChronoLock on the next settings screen."

"Usage access lets ChronoLock read time and opens for each app. History works without blocking rules and is kept for up to 30 days on this device only, never on a server. Accessibility access is not needed just to view history. You can revoke usage access in Android settings at any time."
"Could not read saved data. Reopen the app."

"Could not save the language. Choose it again."
"Monitoring stopped. Turn the accessibility service off and on."
"Choose apps to limit during focus first."
"Enter a time from 00:00 to 23:59, such as 23:00."
"%1$s must be 1 second to 24 hours. Clear all three fields for no limit."
"%1$s: enter a whole number from 1 to %2$s."
"%1$s: enter a whole number from 0 to %3$s for %2$s."
"Pause and choose what you want to do now."
"You have used your daily time allowance."
"You have reached your daily open limit."
"Could not open settings. Enable the permission in Android settings."

"Detects switches to selected apps and shows a blocking screen when your limits are reached. It does not read screen text or input. Data stays on this device. You can disable this service in Android settings at any time."
"Your account stores sign-in details only. Limits and usage history stay on this device."
"Signing in is optional. Every limit feature works without an account."
"You are using the app without ads."
"A banner ad appears at the bottom of Today and History. Ads never appear on the block screen or during focus."
"Your account is deleted from the server and you are signed out. Limits and history on this device stay. This cannot be undone."
